Silver Price in 2026
Among 9 monthly observations available for 2026, the LBMA silver price fell 37.0% between 2026-01-30 ($103) and 2026-09-25 ($65.02). The highest sampled price was $103 in January and the lowest was $57.73 in July. The mean of these observations was $74.11. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
